acq.hint.none.en: Not part of the route test: the ads carry today's links, unchanged.
acq.hint.none.zh: 不参加路径测试：广告沿用现在的链接，不做改动。

acq.hint.store.en: Route A: an App install ad straight to Google Play. The app link says route=store, and the campaign and ad group names end with [cd:<series>] so the app opens the advertised series.
acq.hint.store.zh: 路径 A：应用安装广告直接打开 Google Play。App 链接带 route=store，广告系列和广告组名称以 [cd:<剧集>] 结尾，App 据此打开广告对应的剧集。

acq.hint.lander.en: Route B: a website ad to crazydramas.com/try/<series>, a landing page whose "Get the app" button goes to Google Play. Nothing is bought on the page, so it never optimizes for Purchase. For the first B launch, tick "Start paused; turn on after review" (step 4) or set Launch state to Paused, check the ad in TikTok, then switch it on.
acq.hint.lander.zh: 路径 B：网站广告打开 crazydramas.com/try/<剧集>，落地页上的“获取 App”按钮跳转 Google Play。落地页上不产生购买，所以不会以购买为优化目标。第一次投放路径 B 时，请勾选“默认暂停，审核后再开启”（第 4 步）或把上线状态设为暂停，在 TikTok 中检查广告后再开启。

acq.hint.web.en: Route C: a website ad to the web player with route=web added: the paywall and web payments stay, and the player offers to open the app.
acq.hint.web.zh: 路径 C：网站广告打开网页播放器，链接加上 route=web：付费墙和网页付款保持不变，播放器会提示在 App 中打开。

acq.landerGoal.pageViewsHint.en: Traffic, optimized for landing page views (oCPM). The default until the pixel has Download events.
acq.landerGoal.pageViewsHint.zh: 流量目标，以落地页浏览为优化目标（oCPM）。像素有下载事件之前默认用这个。

acq.landerGoal.downloadsHint.en: Website conversions on the pixel's Download event, fired when someone taps "Get the app". TikTok may refuse it until the pixel has received Download events.
acq.landerGoal.downloadsHint.zh: 网站转化，以像素的下载事件为目标；有人点“获取 App”时触发。像素收到下载事件之前，TikTok 可能会拒绝。

acq.mismatch.en: This route does not fit the launch shape: route A is App install; routes B and C are Website purchases or Traffic. Pick the route again.
acq.mismatch.zh: 该路径与投放类型不符：路径 A 用应用安装；路径 B 和 C 用网站购买或流量。请重新选择路径。

lr2.issue.acquisitionRoute.en: Acquisition routes (A Google Play, B landing page, C web player) are for TikTok launches only. Save the draft again to clear it.
lr2.issue.acquisitionRoute.zh: 获客路径（A Google Play、B 落地页、C 网页播放器）只用于 TikTok 投放。请重新保存草稿以清除。

cdr.none.en: No route numbers yet: they arrive with the next crazydramas release. Spend per route is shown from Studio's launches.
cdr.none.zh: 暂无路径数据：数据随下一次 crazydramas 发布提供。各路径的花费来自 Studio 的投放记录。

cdr.funnel.en: From click to paid, per route

cdr.funnel.info.en: Each route's people at every step, each bar a share of that route's clicks. A has no landing page and no store tap: its ad opens Google Play directly.
cdr.funnel.info.zh: 各路径每一步的人数，每条横条按该路径的点击数计算占比。A 没有落地页和商店点击：广告直接打开 Google Play。

cdr.m.spend.info.en: What TikTok charged for the route's campaigns in the period, from TikTok's own daily report. All: from the first day crazydramas reported routes, never spend from before. A campaign Studio launched takes its launch's route (a launch on no route is in none of A, B, C); any other campaign takes crazydramas' route.
cdr.m.spend.info.zh: 该路径的广告系列在所选时间段内的 TikTok 花费，来自 TikTok 每日报告。全部：从 crazydramas 第一次上报路径数据的那天算起，不计之前的花费。Studio 投放的广告系列按投放时选的路径计（未选路径的投放不计入 A、B、C）；其他广告系列按 crazydramas 上报的路径计。

cdr.m.impressions.info.en: Times TikTok showed the route's ads in the period.
cdr.m.impressions.info.zh: 该路径的广告在所选时间段内被 TikTok 展示的次数。

cdr.m.clicks.info.en: Clicks on the route's ads, as TikTok counts them.
cdr.m.clicks.info.zh: 该路径广告的点击次数，按 TikTok 的统计。

cdr.m.landed.info.en: People who opened the landing page (B) or the player from a route=web ad (C). A has no page in between.
cdr.m.landed.info.zh: 打开落地页（B）或通过 route=web 广告打开播放器（C）的人数。A 中间没有页面。

cdr.m.store_taps.info.en: People who tapped through to Google Play from crazydramas.com. A's ad opens Google Play itself.
cdr.m.store_taps.info.zh: 从 crazydramas.com 点击跳转到 Google Play 的人数。A 的广告直接打开 Google Play。

cdr.m.installs.info.en: App installs credited to the route, counted at the app's first launch.
cdr.m.installs.info.zh: 归因到该路径的 App 安装，以 App 第一次打开计。

cdr.m.opened_episode.info.en: Installs whose first launch opened the advertised series.
cdr.m.opened_episode.info.zh: 第一次打开 App 就进入广告对应剧集的安装数。

cdr.m.trials.info.en: People who started a VIP free trial, on the web or through the app store.
cdr.m.trials.info.zh: 开始 VIP 免费试用的人数，网页或应用商店均计。

cdr.m.paid.info.en: People with a paid purchase, on the web or in the app store; trials that turned paid included.
cdr.m.paid.info.zh: 有付费购买的人数，网页或应用商店均计；试用转为付费的也算。

cdr.m.repeat_viewers.info.en: People who started episodes on two or more different days.
cdr.m.repeat_viewers.info.zh: 在两天或以上开始观看剧集的人数。

cdr.m.revenue.info.en: Gross paid by the route's people, before store and Stripe fees.
cdr.m.revenue.info.zh: 该路径用户的付款总额，未扣除应用商店和 Stripe 手续费。

cdr.m.per_install.info.en: Spend on the campaigns whose spend is known, divided by the installs from those campaigns. Installs with no campaign, or from a campaign Studio has no spend for, are listed under the table instead. A dash when there is no such spend or nobody installed.
cdr.m.per_install.info.zh: 花费已知的广告系列的花费，除以这些广告系列带来的安装数。没有广告系列、或来自 Studio 没有花费数据的广告系列的安装，单独列在表格下方。没有这样的花费或无人安装时显示短横线。

cdr.m.per_trial.info.en: Spend on the campaigns whose spend is known, divided by the trials from those campaigns.
cdr.m.per_trial.info.zh: 花费已知的广告系列的花费，除以这些广告系列带来的试用人数。

cdr.m.per_paid.info.en: Spend on the campaigns whose spend is known, divided by the people from those campaigns who paid.
cdr.m.per_paid.info.zh: 花费已知的广告系列的花费，除以这些广告系列带来的付款人数。

cdr.unmatchedInfo.en: People crazydramas counted on a route with no TikTok campaign (AppsFlyer named none), or from a campaign Studio has no spend for (not launched by Studio, or its spend not reported). They are in the route's totals above, but no cost divides them.
cdr.unmatchedInfo.zh: crazydramas 在某条路径上统计到、但没有 TikTok 广告系列（AppsFlyer 未提供）、或来自 Studio 没有花费数据的广告系列（非 Studio 投放，或花费未上报）的人。他们计入上面的路径合计，但不参与任何成本计算。

cdr.allFrom.en: All: from {day}, the first day crazydramas reported routes.
cdr.allFrom.zh: 全部：自 {day} 起，即 crazydramas 第一次上报路径数据的那天。
